window_x.description: Initial X coordinate of the curtain window in pixels.

window_y.description: Initial Y coordinate of the curtain window in pixels.

window_width.description: Initial width of the curtain window in pixels.

window_height.description: Initial height of the curtain window in pixels.

opacity.description: Opacity level between 0.0 (fully transparent) and 1.0 (fully opaque).

color.description: Background color in 6-digit hex format (e.g., #000000 for black).

always_on_top.description: Whether the curtain window should stay on top of all others.

hide_cursor.description: Whether to hide the mouse cursor while the curtain is active.

auto_start.description: Whether to automatically start curtain on user session start.
